function PlotThemes.getTheme(index: number)
	local n = #PlotThemes.Themes
	local i = ((math.floor(tonumber(index) or 1) - 1) % n) + 1
	return PlotThemes.Themes[i]
end

-- World CFrame of a plot's center (top of the ground at GroundY), facing the plaza (-Z toward center).
function PlotThemes.getSlotCFrame(index: number): CFrame
	local L = PlotThemes.Layout
	local a = math.rad(((index - 1) % PlotThemes.PLOT_COUNT) * (360 / PlotThemes.PLOT_COUNT))
	local pos = L.PlazaCenter + Vector3.new(math.sin(a) * L.RingRadius, L.GroundY, math.cos(a) * L.RingRadius)
	local target = Vector3.new(L.PlazaCenter.X, pos.Y, L.PlazaCenter.Z)
	return CFrame.lookAt(pos, target)
end

-- Idempotency helper for builders: returns true the first time a key is seen
-- (e.g. PlotThemes.markBuilt("plot_" .. theme.name)), false afterwards.
local builtKeys: { [string]: boolean } = {}
function PlotThemes.markBuilt(key: string): boolean
	if builtKeys[key] then
		return false
	end
	builtKeys[key] = true
	return true
end

-- One-shot build counters can never exceed their expected total, even if a
-- builder accidentally runs twice.
local COUNTER_CAPS: { [string]: number } = {
	themes_built = PlotThemes.PLOT_COUNT,
	plaza_built = 1,
}
local counterTotals: { [string]: number } = {}

-- Server-only safe telemetry bump (plaza_built, themes_built, plots_claimed, auto_claims).
function PlotThemes.bump(name: string, n: number?)
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	local amount = n or 1
	local cap = COUNTER_CAPS[name]
	if cap then
		local used = counterTotals[name] or 0
		local remaining = cap - used
		if remaining <= 0 then
			return
		end
		amount = math.min(amount, remaining)
		counterTotals[name] = used + amount
	end
	local mod = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ForgeTelemetry")
	if not mod then
		return
	end
	local ok, tele = pcall(require, mod)
	if ok and type(tele) == "table" and type(tele.count) == "function" then
		pcall(tele.count, name, amount)
	end
end

Chain the first few upgrades so there is always something affordable to chase in the first minute, with no long dead gaps.
- Starting cash must be strictly below the first upgrade's price, never equal to it. An instant spend gives the player no chase and no sense of what cubes are for. function PlotThemes.getTheme(index: number)
	local n = #PlotThemes.Themes
	local i = ((math.floor(tonumber(index) or 1) - 1) % n) + 1
	return PlotThemes.Themes[i]
end

-- World CFrame of a plot's center (top of the ground at GroundY), facing the plaza (-Z toward center).
function PlotThemes.getSlotCFrame(index: number): CFrame
	local L = PlotThemes.Layout
	local a = math.rad(((index - 1) % PlotThemes.PLOT_COUNT) * (360 / PlotThemes.PLOT_COUNT))
	local pos = L.PlazaCenter + Vector3.new(math.sin(a) * L.RingRadius, L.GroundY, math.cos(a) * L.RingRadius)
	local target = Vector3.new(L.PlazaCenter.X, pos.Y, L.PlazaCenter.Z)
	return CFrame.lookAt(pos, target)
end

-- Idempotency helper for builders: returns true the first time a key is seen
-- (e.g. PlotThemes.markBuilt("plot_" .. theme.name)), false afterwards.
local builtKeys: { [string]: boolean } = {}
function PlotThemes.markBuilt(key: string): boolean
	if builtKeys[key] then
		return false
	end
	builtKeys[key] = true
	return true
end

-- One-shot build counters can never exceed their expected total, even if a
-- builder accidentally runs twice.
local COUNTER_CAPS: { [string]: number } = {
	themes_built = PlotThemes.PLOT_COUNT,
	plaza_built = 1,
}
local counterTotals: { [string]: number } = {}

-- Server-only safe telemetry bump (plaza_built, themes_built, plots_claimed, auto_claims).
function PlotThemes.bump(name: string, n: number?)
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	local amount = n or 1
	local cap = COUNTER_CAPS[name]
	if cap then
		local used = counterTotals[name] or 0
		local remaining = cap - used
		if remaining <= 0 then
			return
		end
		amount = math.min(amount, remaining)
		counterTotals[name] = used + amount
	end
	local mod = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ForgeTelemetry")
	if not mod then
		return
	end
	local ok, tele = pcall(require, mod)
	if ok and type(tele) == "table" and type(tele.count) == "function" then
		pcall(tele.count, name, amount)
	end
end

-- Ambient life: for each plot, a small pulsing glow orb floats above every decor
-- prop (Transparency 0 -> 0.3 over 1.5s, looping) and a low-rate ParticleEmitter
-- drifts over the plot (fireflies, snow, embers, ...). Server-only, built once.
local PULSE_INFO = TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)

local function buildPlotAmbient(folder: Folder, slot: number)
	local theme = PlotThemes.getTheme(slot)
	local slotCF = PlotThemes.getSlotCFrame(slot)
	local amb = theme.ambient

	-- Pulsing glow orbs over decor.
	for i, d in ipairs(theme.decor) do
		local orb = Instance.new("Part")
		orb.Name = "AmbientGlow_" .. theme.name .. "_" .. i
		orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		orb.Size = Vector3.new(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
		orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		orb.Color = d.color
		orb.Transparency = 0
		orb.Anchored = true
		orb.CanCollide = false
		orb.CanTouch = false
		orb.CanQuery = false
		orb.CastShadow = false
		orb.CFrame = CFrame.new(slotCF:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(d.offset.X, d.offset.Y + 7, d.offset.Z)))
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = d.color
		light.Range = 8
		light.Brightness = 1
		light.Parent = orb
		orb.Parent = folder
		local tween = TweenService:Create(orb, PULSE_INFO, { Transparency = 0.3 })
		tween:Play()
	end

	-- Ambient particles.
	if amb then
		local h = amb.height or 2
		local emitterPart = Instance.new("Part")
		emitterPart.Name = "AmbientEmitter_" .. theme.name
		emitterPart.Size = Vector3.new(34, 0.5, 34)
		emitterPart.Transparency = 1
		emitterPart.Anchored = true
		emitterPart.CanCollide = false
		emitterPart.CanTouch = false
		emitterPart.CanQuery = false
		emitterPart.CastShadow = false
		emitterPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(slotCF:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 1 + h, 0)))

		local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		pe.Name = "AmbientParticles"
		pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(amb.color)
		pe.LightEmission = 0.8
		pe.Rate = amb.rate
		pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(amb.lifetime * 0.8, amb.lifetime * 1.2)
		pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(amb.speed * 0.5, amb.speed)
		pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25)
		pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, amb.size),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, amb.size),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, 0.2),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.3),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		pe.EmissionDirection = amb.down and Enum.NormalId.Bottom or Enum.NormalId.Top
		pe.Parent = emitterPart
		emitterPart.Parent = folder
	end
end

function PlotThemes.buildAmbient()
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	if not PlotThemes.markBuilt("ambient_all") then
		return
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "PlotAmbient"
	for slot = 1, PlotThemes.PLOT_COUNT do
		local ok, err = pcall(buildPlotAmbient, folder, slot)
		if not ok then
			warn("PlotThemes ambient failed for slot " .. slot .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	folder.Parent = Workspace
end

-- Start ambient motion automatically on the server (once, shortly after load).
if RunService:IsServer() then
	task.delay(1, function()
		PlotThemes.buildAmbient()
	end)
end

return PlotThemes
